population.entity.rationale: 题面问"Which customer"，客户实体；Schema 中 customer_id 是 customer 主键且被 payment.customer_id 外键引用

population.eligibility.value: 只纳入在观测期内有支付记录的客户；无任何支付记录的客户没有支付金额也无月度变化，不参与排名。同时客户至少需要两个月度观测点（相邻月份）才能产生"变化"。
population.eligibility.rationale: 题面要求"月度变化"，没有支付记录的客户无法定义该指标

population.time.value: 全部可用支付历史（题面未指定时间范围，不设时间过滤）

population.missing.value: 不补零：只在客户存在支付的相邻自然月之间计算环比；没有支付的月份不视为 0

measure.countGrain.value: 在客户-自然月粒度上聚合支付金额（每个客户每月一行，对 payment.amount 求和/求平均）；再在客户粒度上对相邻月的差值求平均
measure.countGrain.rationale: 题面"monthly"指向自然月聚合粒度

measure.denominator.value: avg 的分母是该客户参与计算的相邻月份对（月度变化）个数；分母为 0 的客户不参与排名

population.joinMultiplicity.value: customer ↔ payment 为 1:N（payment.customer_id → customer.customer_id）。按客户聚合支付金额时每个 payment 行只计一次，不会因连接重复计数；客户端属性在客户粒度上取任一行即可。

arguments.sql: SELECT MIN(payment_date) AS min_dt, MAX(payment_date) AS max_dt, COUNT(*) AS n_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS n_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date)) AS n_months FROM payment;

SELECT months_with_payment, COUNT(*) AS n_customers FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date)) AS months_with_payment FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) GROUP BY months_with_payment ORDER BY months_with_payment;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS ym, SUM(amount) AS val
  FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id, ym
), j AS (
  SELECT m1.customer_id AS customer_id, m1.val - m2.val AS chg
  FROM monthly m1
  JOIN monthly m2
    ON m2.customer_id = m1.customer_id
   AND m2.ym = strftime('%Y-%m', date(m1.ym || '-01', '-1 month'))
), a AS (
  SELECT customer_id, AVG(chg) AS metric FROM j GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name, ROUND(a.metric,2) AS avg_monthly_change
FROM a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
ORDER BY a.metric DESC LIMIT 5;

WITH months AS (SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS ym FROM payment),
cust AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM payment),
grid AS (SELECT c.customer_id, m.ym FROM cust c CROSS JOIN months m),
filled AS (
  SELECT g.customer_id, g.ym, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) AS val
  FROM grid g LEFT JOIN payment p
    ON p.customer_id = g.customer_id AND strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date) = g.ym
  GROUP BY g.customer_id, g.ym
), d AS (
  SELECT customer_id, val - LAG(val) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY ym) AS chg FROM filled
), a AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(chg) AS metric FROM d WHERE chg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name, ROUND(a.metric,2) AS avg_monthly_change
FROM a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
ORDER BY a.metric DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS ym, COUNT(*) AS n_pay, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS n_cust, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS total
FROM payment GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS ym, AVG(amount) AS val
  FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id, ym
), j AS (
  SELECT m1.customer_id AS customer_id, m1.val - m2.val AS chg
  FROM monthly m1 JOIN monthly m2
    ON m2.customer_id = m1.customer_id
   AND m2.ym = strftime('%Y-%m', date(m1.ym || '-01', '-1 month'))
), a AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(chg) AS metric FROM j GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name
FROM a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
ORDER BY a.metric DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS ym, SUM(amount) AS val
  FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id, ym
), j AS (
  SELECT m1.customer_id AS customer_id, (m1.val - m2.val) * 1.0 / m2.val AS chg
  FROM monthly m1 JOIN monthly m2
    ON m2.customer_id = m1.customer_id
   AND m2.ym = strftime('%Y-%m', date(m1.ym || '-01', '-1 month'))
  WHERE m2.val <> 0
), a AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(chg) AS metric FROM j GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name
FROM a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
ORDER BY a.metric DESC LIMIT 1;

population.missing.reason: 按 S07 “相邻观测不等于相邻日历期”修正：跨月缺口不得当作环比
population.missing.value: 不补零（无业务证据证明缺月代表零活动）；只在两个日历月份严格相邻（如 2005-07 与 2005-08）时计算一次月度变化；跨月缺口（2005-08 → 2006-02）不计作“月度变化”而被排除。
population.missing.rationale: 方法指引 S07：相邻观测不等于相邻日历期，缺一个月时不能把跨月跳跃自动当作环比；sql-rules §6 要求日历相邻时验证周期差。无业务定义确认缺月为零活动，故不补零。

measure.formula.rationale: 将三候选逐词放回题面：题面说 "change in payment amounts"，是“支付金额”的变化，量纲应为金额（美元）→ 用绝对差值 difference，排除相对变化率（候选 C）；“payment amounts”的月度取值是该客户当月支付的金额合计 → 月内用 sum（候选 A），排除月内均值（候选 B）；外层 "average" 即对客户各次月度变化取平均。探针验证：A → MICHEAL FORMAN，B 与 C → ASHLEY RICHARDSON，A 与 B/C 输出不同；Jev 建议的最大概率候选为 A（概率 0.32，B 仅 0.04），故采纳 A。

selection.ties.reason: 题面为单数 argmax（Which customer，最高值），且经验证无并列（第二位为 34.93），取恰好 1 行

arguments.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT p.customer_id AS customer_id,
         strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date) AS ym,
         SUM(p.amount) AS val
  FROM payment p
  GROUP BY p.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date)
), pairs AS (
  SELECT m1.customer_id AS customer_id,
         m1.val - m2.val AS chg
  FROM monthly m1
  JOIN monthly m2
    ON m2.customer_id = m1.customer_id
   AND m2.ym = strftime('%Y-%m', date(m1.ym || '-01', '-1 month'))
), avg_chg AS (
  SELECT customer_id, AVG(chg) AS avg_monthly_change
  FROM pairs GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name
FROM avg_chg a
JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
ORDER BY a.avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH months AS (SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS ym FROM payment),
cust AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM payment),
grid AS (SELECT c.customer_id, m.ym FROM cust c CROSS JOIN months m),
filled AS (
  SELECT g.customer_id, g.ym, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) AS val
  FROM grid g LEFT JOIN payment p
    ON p.customer_id = g.customer_id AND strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date) = g.ym
  GROUP BY g.customer_id, g.ym
), d AS (
  SELECT customer_id, val - LAG(val) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY ym) AS chg FROM filled
), a AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(chg) AS metric FROM d WHERE chg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name, ROUND(a.metric,2) AS avg_monthly_change
FROM a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
ORDER BY a.metric DESC LIMIT 5;

population.missing.value: 不补零（无业务证据证明缺月代表零活动）；只在两个日历月份严格相邻（如 2005-07 与 2005-08）时计算一次月度变化；跨月缺口（2005-08 → 2006-02）不计作“月度变化”而被排除。
population.missing.rationale: 方法指引 S07：相邻观测不等于相邻日历期，缺一个月时不能把跨月跳跃自动当作环比；sql-rules §6 要求日历相邻时验证周期差。无业务定义确认缺月为零活动，故不补零。

measure.formula.rationale: 将三候选逐词放回题面：题面说 "change in payment amounts"，是“支付金额”的变化，量纲应为金额（美元）→ 用绝对差值 difference，排除相对变化率（候选 C）；“payment amounts”的月度取值是该客户当月支付的金额合计 → 月内用 sum（候选 A），排除月内均值（候选 B）；外层 "average" 即对客户各次月度变化取平均。探针验证：A → MICHEAL FORMAN，B 与 C → ASHLEY RICHARDSON，A 与 B/C 输出不同；Jev 建议的最大概率候选为 A（概率 0.32，B 仅 0.04），故采纳 A。

args.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT p.customer_id AS customer_id,
         strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date) AS ym,
         SUM(p.amount) AS val
  FROM payment p
  GROUP BY p.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date)
), pairs AS (
  SELECT m1.customer_id AS customer_id,
         m1.val - m2.val AS chg
  FROM monthly m1
  JOIN monthly m2
    ON m2.customer_id = m1.customer_id
   AND m2.ym = strftime('%Y-%m', date(m1.ym || '-01', '-1 month'))
), avg_chg AS (
  SELECT customer_id, AVG(chg) AS avg_monthly_change
  FROM pairs GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name
FROM avg_chg a
JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
ORDER BY a.avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1;
